The Court made the following Order:
The present Writ Petition arises out of a dispute as to the ownership of 686.81 sq.meters of land in Sy.No.462/2A of Poranki Village, Penamaluru Mandal, Krishna District.

This land was acquired under the provisions of the National Highways Act,
1956.
2.
On account of the dispute between the writ petitioner herein and the respondents 7 to 10, the amount awarded, as compensation, has been deposited in the joint account of the Competent Authority.
It may also be noted that the dispute had also been raised before the Civil Court, by way of O.S.No.35 of 2007, in the Court of XIV Additional District Judge, Vijayawada, Krishna District.

entities.text: XIV Additional District Judge, Vijayawada, Krishna District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This suit was decreed in favour of the petitioner.
However, the respondents 7 to 10, being aggrieved by the said Judgment and decree, have approached this Court, by way of A.S.No.788 of 2019 and the same is pending before this Court.

3. In view of the aforesaid civil litigation, it would only be appropriate that this Writ Petition is disposed of, with a direction to the respondent authorities to disburse the compensation amount, with such interest as may be permissible, to the party which succeeds in the civil litigation.

Such disbursement shall take place within six (06)
weeks from the date of which the certified copy of the decision of this Court is placed before the authorities.
It is also directed that the compensation be deposited in an interest bearing fixed RRR, J deposit with a nationalized scheduled Bank.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
